item.title: Srinivasa Ramanujan
item.description: As a rather young undergrad outside of the last few years I have no interest in mathematics. Well that isn't quite right, rather the interest I did have was left alone outside on the cold infertile ground. Upon reinvigorating one of what is practically my largest passion, and luckily skillset, I decided to dive into some history surrounding the field as a whole.
